current_approved_policy: Strict >=150B hard excluded in policies/limits.json; this file is ONLY a future exception-policy proposal, NOT an authorization to use/modify approval or download.
new_user_preference: Treat <150B full-total models as normal candidates; contemplate >150B only for quantized, uniquely modified/specialized, demonstrably useful/quality-checked versions.
notes: Full original parameters and quantized artifact tensor metadata must be separately recorded. Quantization alone never reduces original parameter count.
A LoRA by itself is an adapter, not a runnable complete model.
Different source-model baselines must never be compared by top-1 agreement percentages as if they are cross-model quality scores.
Specialized metrics and noninferiority thresholds must be defined before model performance claims.
Gated, license and data consent may not be bypassed by future public-distribution hypotheses.
Real PC active downloads are user-reported, not verified by this GitHub research. GitHub queues/approved.json is empty and cannot attest to external download status.
No download, delete, overwrite, or change to existing queues, manifests, CURRENT.json, policy files, or model binaries was performed.
